# plan-B10 WP4' (angle B5 of report2-weyl.html) -- pressure / Bowen-zero layer.
# The model system of Z32/ModelEntropy.lean has affine branches of slope 3/2, so its
# pressure is affine: P(t) = phi_model(U) - t log(3/2)  (Z32.Pressure.modelPressure_eq).
# The Bowen zero is t* = phi/log(3/2); the dyadic (Flatto) exponent is s0 = phi/log 2;
# s0 = t* * log_2(3/2).  Each bracket below is TWO INTEGER COMPARISONS,
#     n/d <= log(x)/log(r)   <==>   r^n <= x^d,
# so no logarithm, real number or floating-point value reaches the Lean kernel.
# Generated by Z32/pressure.py; every row re-checked independently, and read back out
# of the Lean source, by Z32/verify_pressure.py.  Shipped in Z32/Pressure.lean.
#
# columns: window | base | u <= lam_lo | lam_hi <= v | certified bracket n1/d1 .. n2/d2
#          | midpoint | width | largest kernel integer (decimal digits)

# The Z-cell ell = 1/2 is exact, not bracketed: phi_model = log(3/2)
# (Z32.Flatto.phiModel_zCell), hence
#   Bowen zero  t*(1/2) = 1                     (Z32.Pressure.modelBowen_zCell)
#   dyadic      s0(1/2) = log_2(3/2) = 0.5849625007  (Z32.Pressure.flattoExponent_zCell)
# The Bowen column saturating at 1 is plan-B10's F2 wall in dimension language: the
# model's own conformal exponent carries no information at the top of the family, so
# the live target delta < 0.585 lives in the dyadic column.

# Kernel cost (LEAN_NUM_THREADS=3, this machine).  The pressure layer adds NO `decide`:
# it reuses the seven WP3 certificates unchanged.  Its own work is numeral
# exponentiation, which is GMP-accelerated:
#   28 power comparisons, integers up to 51202 digits ... 0.27 s  (1.51 s vs 1.24 s bare import)
#   Z32/Pressure.lean, whole file .................... 2.3  s  (3.94 s vs 1.62 s own imports)
# So trigger (j) of report2-weyl.html (`t`-weighting must stay inside WP3's ~20-digit
# envelope) does not bind: t-weighting never touches TypeCert.ok.
